The American Dream is the promise of a process: if you work hard, and make smart and virtuous decisions, you will live a better life than your parents, and your children will live a better life than you do. That process requires free markets, free minds, equal justice before law, and social fabric. Government’s job is to protect the American Dream. Don’t listen to the demoralization agents trying to destroy it in the name of utopian schemes, Left and Right.
